text:
lina: Quick thread on the Feature Flag rollout form: inline errors vs top summary, required markers, and the delete/disable confirm UX. Prototype: https://figma.redwood/flags

omar: For flag forms I favor inline errors immediately under the control; flags can be dense and inline helps surface exact problem. If multiple errors after submit show a compact top summary with anchors.

gwen: Agree. Required marker idea: asterisk for small boolean toggles, but for complex fields (targeting rules) show a visible "Required" helper and a first-run tooltip.

pat: On destructive action: disabling vs deleting a flag. Deleting should be high-friction. Ops wants typed-confirm but we could use typed-confirm only when flag is live in prod or used by >5 services. Otherwise checkbox + undo toast.

lina: Love the tiered confirm. Also propose a short countdown (3s) for mid-risk deletes. Must be keyboard accessible and skip-able for reduced-motion.

omar: Accessibility: inline errors must use aria-describedby, and any top summary anchors should move focus to the related input and expand collapsed sections. Use aria-live="assertive" for blocking errors.

gwen: Microcopy: don't say "Invalid". Use "Rule name  must be unique" or "Targeting expression  syntax error: unexpected token at position 12." Include actionable hints.

pat: Telemetry: record confirm_kind (typed|checkbox|countdown), delete_risk (low|medium|high), and validation_mode (inline|hybrid). We'll review after rollout.

devops-bot: Note: security policy requires typed-confirm if flag grants external access. Will publish a rule set.

lina: Small UI nit: if helper text exists reserve the space to avoid layout shift when showing errors. Also error links should use explicit labels like "Fix rule name".

omar: Tests: E2E for focus jump from summary, SR announces inline errors, typed-confirm exact-match, countdown respects prefers-reduced-motion.

gwen: Action items: lina -> update Figma with inline + summary variants and three confirm flows; omar -> draft aria/id patterns and e2e tests; pat -> telemetry + config for tier rules; I'll follow security rules on typed-confirm.

lina: Thanks all 680. Will ping when mocks ready.
